title: Small SARS-CoV-2 VCF fixture for kent vcfFilter tests

provenance.source_observations: Unknown original source; fixture header states source=faToVcf refPlus.unmapped.aligned.fasta stdout and reference=refPlus.unmapped.aligned.fasta:NC_045512v2.
adaptations: VCF test input used to compare vcfFilter output under rename, allele-count and excluded-position options.
provenance.status: fixture contains variant/genotype rows; exact upstream observations and transformation history beyond header are unknown

experimental_units: VCF sample columns include named SARS-CoV-2 sequences with place/date and some accession-like strings; header shows 12 sample columns
biological_context.assay: Sequence variation represented in VCF; original assay unknown.
biological_context.design: Unknown; test fixture header suggests aligned FASTA inputs, not study design.
metadata: Reference label NC_045512v2; VCF 4.2; genotype calls and AC/AN INFO values are present.

assets.processing_stage: small test input; reference label NC_045512v2; source header indicates faToVcf conversion from an aligned FASTA
assets.relationship: Test fixture consumed by vcfFilter tests; input/exclude.vcf is a separate positional exclusion fixture whose shared source identity is not established.

access_and_terms.access: Public repository file at the pinned revision.
access_and_terms.redistribution: Unknown for underlying sample sequences and fixture; repository license does not establish terms for third-party data embedded in the fixture.

inspection.checked: Read test VCF header and bounded file body at the pinned revision; tree metadata reports 8,902 bytes. Header gives reference and faToVcf source and contains named sample columns. Did not download any external biological asset or execute vcfFilter.
unverified: Original aligned FASTA, submitting study, sample provenance, exact sequence count underlying unusual INFO values in later records, and third-party reuse terms.

limitations: Treat as an implementation fixture only until provenance and licensing are resolved. Sample labels do not provide a study accession or adequate biological design. It should not be presumed representative or redistribution-cleared.

assets.relationship: One member of the Personalis named variant test set.

assets.processing_stage: variant input fixture, named disagreement partition
assets.relationship: Same named test set by filename and test rule; header/assembly not independently previewed.

assets.processing_stage: patch-assembly variant fixture; file says hg38 and describes a patch sequence absent from hg19
assets.relationship: Same named test set by filename and test rule; patch-coordinate cases are retained as a distinct asset.

access_and_terms.access: Public text files in the pinned repository revision.
access_and_terms.redistribution: Unknown. File attribution and GitHub availability do not establish underlying clinical variant or benchmark redistribution terms.
